title: Microsoft AI opens review on Humanist AI Code of Conduct
summary: Microsoft AI has published a draft Humanist AI Code of Conduct, opening a six-week public consultation on operational constraints for model training and deployment. The draft serves as a technical manual defining system behaviour, operational boundaries, and oversight protocols a
reason: Item reports a corporate voluntary AI code of conduct draft and public consultation from Microsoft, a company rather than an official/regulatory body. It is not a model release, research paper, industry deal/market event, or government policy action, so no active rule covers it.
